checks.title: Regenerated snapshots contain only the guarded attribute
checks.method: Every added line in each .g.cs file must be one of the 3 allowed lines; no line may be removed.
checks.rerun: git diff -U0 origin/master...origin/ju26-issue-2297 -- '*.g.cs' | grep '^[+-]' | grep -v '^+++\|^---' | sort | uniq -c

checks.title: Each T4 template and its generated C# change together
checks.method: Count attribute insertions in each .tt and in its .cs twin; they must match.

checks.title: Changes to files the reviewer may not decide on
checks.method: Any change to a policy file is routed to the owner, whatever the diff looks like.
checks.rerun: git diff origin/master...origin/ju26-issue-2297 -- Directory.Packages.props Directory.Build.props global.json

changes.why: Dependency and toolchain versions decide which customers can use the package.
